name: Foxnet Australia
summary: Mornington Peninsula dialup ISP; succeeded by Satlink Internet Services by late 1998 (fox.net.au redirect). Founder later sold the business (2005). FOXNET AUSTRALIA PTY LTD, ACN 075 913 414.

events.details: Dialup (Melbourne/Mornington Peninsula local call). Earliest verified Wayback capture 29 Jan 1997.
fox.net.au redirected to satlink.com.au by 5 Dec 1998 ('Foxnet is now located at http://www.satlink.com.au/', Wayback). Founder John Barton sold the business to a public company in 2005.
